tasks.title: Fix session validation
tasks.objective: Reject expired sessions without touching valid ones
tasks.estimate_rationale: Localised change, sensitive because it touches auth

complexity.justification: Short pure function change with a clear failing case, no design choices to make

scope.justification: Only the expiry branch of one validator changes; callers and the API surface stay as they are

duration.justification: Comparable to the earlier token-expiry fix: read, patch, add two cases, run the auth tests

risk.justification: A wrong check either locks valid users out or lets expired sessions through, so it is security sensitive

coupling.justification: Both clients read the session contract, so the change must keep its shape and a task consumes it

confidence.justification: The code and its tests were read and the same change was made before in this module

tasks.title: Document the session contract
tasks.objective: Document session expiry behaviour for API consumers
tasks.estimate_rationale: Prose only; behaviour already fixed in T1
acceptance_criteria: The doc states expired sessions are rejected

complexity.justification: Prose only; the behaviour it describes is already fixed by the previous task

scope.justification: A single document changes and nothing else in the repository is touched

duration.justification: Short page edit comparable to the other docs pages, reviewed by reading the diff

risk.justification: Documentation error is cosmetic, easy to correct and not user-facing in production

coupling.justification: The page describes the contract T1 changes, but it only reads it and is ordered after it

confidence.justification: The document exists and the described behaviour is exactly what T1 delivers
